thought.text: Ketemu endpoint-nya. Saya tarik daftar bounty yang masih buka.

reasoning_content:
`/api/competitions?status=open` works! Let me fetch that and analyze: prizes, entry fees, deadlines, entries count.

Let me get the full list with fields.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://make.fun/api/competitions?status=open" -o /tmp/open.json -w "size=%{size_download}\n"; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/open.json'))
items=d.get('items',[])
print("jumlah bounty buka:",len(items))
print("field:",list(items[0].keys()) if items else "-")
PY
